parts.title: Market Morning
parts.text: On Saturday morning, Aisha, Pedro, and Lena went to the town market. The sun was warm, and music played somewhere nearby. Aisha carried a big **basket**. The street was full of noise and **bustle**. Every path was **crowded** with shoppers.

parts.title: The Fruit Stall
parts.text: At the first **stall**, a man had peaches in a tall **heap**. The fruit looked **ripe** and **juicy**. “Would you like to **sample** one?” he asked. Pedro took a slice and smiled.

parts.title: Sweet Smells
parts.text: Next came the flower table. The roses were **fragrant**, and the woman who sold them was **cheerful**. She used a scale to **weigh** a bag of cherries. Then the smell of warm bread began to **tempt** Lena. She could not walk past without a taste.

parts.title: A Good Trip
parts.text: They sat on a bench and shared the warm bread. Pedro said it was the best part of the day. Lena said she wanted to come back next week, and Aisha agreed. Then they walked home, tired and happy.
